thread:
Ava: Quick check — problem surfaced in support: users think console 'Save' is a lightweight session snapshot, but backend treats everything as a savedquery for quotas/alerts. This is inflating owned saved-query counts for teams. Need proposal.
Liam: Could we add a `mode` on saves: `snapshot` vs `library`? Snapshot = ephemeral, auto-expire; library = persistent.
Priya: UX: present a tiny inline menu on the save button: "Quick snapshot (temporary)" and "Save to library". Default could be Quick for first-time users? Not sure.
Maya: Pref default = Quick snapshot for exploratory flows. Persisted saves are a deliberate action. That reduces accidental pollution.
Noah: Implementation-wise: DB add column `mode` ENUM('snapshot','library'), add `expires_at` for snapshot. API: POST /saved_queries accept mode & session_id.
Liam: Migration: existing rows set mode='library'. Queries that compute quotas should filter where mode='library' OR include flag.
Priya: Telemetry: emit `save.mode` and `save.intent` (e.g., user_clicked_save, autosave) so analytics can segment. Example event: {"event":"console.save","mode":"snapshot","route":"r-42","model":"m-latest","session_id":"sid-9"}
Ava: Routing note: snapshots inherit current route/model pins for preview only and must never create rollout records or alter routing policies. They are read-only for routing.
Noah: On the Console list: two sections 'Session snapshots' and 'Library' with filter chips. Snapshots have clock icon + ttl. Users can promote snapshot -> library explicitly.
Maya: Promote action should open a small modal: "Promote snapshot to library? This will count against your team's saved query quota."
Liam: Quotas: Add metric `saved_queries_library_count` and deprecate the old generic one. For backwards compatibility keep old metric but document migration. Dashboards should default to library-only.
Priya: Also add a debug toggle in quota dashboard: "Include session snapshots" for auditing. Default off.
Noah: API change checklist: add `mode` param, session-scoped storage for snapshots, TTL enforcement job, promotion endpoint `POST /saved_queries/:id/promote`.
Liam: DB pseudo: `ALTER TABLE saved_queries ADD COLUMN mode text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'library'; ALTER TABLE saved_queries ADD COLUMN expires_at timestamptz;` Backfill existing as library.
Ava: Rollout plan: feature-flag the UI + API. Stage 1 internal opt-in, collect telemetry for 2 weeks, watch delta in saved query counts and support volume.
Maya: UX copy variants: 1) "Quick snapshot (expires after 24h, won't appear in team lists)" 2) "Snapshot (temporary)". I'll post A/B copy in #product.
Priya: One more telemetry ask: when a snapshot is promoted, fire `console.save.promote` with original `created_by_session` and `promoted_by`. This helps debugging accidental promotions.
Noah: I'll mock screenshots. Also implement the clock icon and TTL badge.
Liam: I'll draft migration PR + API changes. Add feature flag gate and rollout phasing in the PR description.
deploy-bot: Proposal doc published: <https://redwood.internal/docs/console-snapshots-v1|console-snapshots-v1> - deployed to staging.
Ava: Action items: Maya (copy variants), Noah (UI spike + staging screenshots), Liam (API + migration + feature flag), Priya (telemetry schema + events), Ava (rollout & support comms). Meet tomorrow 10am to review staging metrics.
